summary: One of the chain's three links holds, and only for half the prompts. Comparing the whole pinned block rather than its opening, 9 of the 18 rendered prompts carry it - the nine final prompts, rendered from the committed revision 2. The other nine are the superseded P22 attempts, rendered from revision 1, which was revised before it was ever committed, so they tie to no pinned template at all. None has an unfilled placeholder. Link two does not hold: the prompts name their input by relative path rather than by digest, and two normalised shapes each stand for three different packets. Link three has nothing to check, because no cell ran. probes/frozen-inputs.json is written by this launch.
establishes: Link one for the nine prompts rendered from the committed template, the no-unfilled-placeholder precondition over all eighteen, and that the checker now refuses both a prompt rendered from a superseded revision and a normalised shape that stands for more than one input.
residual: Previously recorded as 'all 18 prompts carry the pinned block'. That came from a check on the block's first 200 bytes, which a prompt rendered from a superseded revision shares; the whole-block comparison is what separates them. A freeze has to pin every template revision a retained prompt was rendered from, or it cannot tie that prompt to anything. The first run, under the prefix rule, is retained under run-1/.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
